_doc: Mid-recon surprise event templates (slice #162). When the realized cost exceeds the estimate band by surpriseThreshold (recon-variance.json), one template is selected by realized bucket from this catalog. Reason text surfaces to the player on the inventory:recon_surprise event.

templates.reason: Transmission slip on lift — full fluid + filter service required.
Brake rotors warped beyond machine spec — rotors + pads all four.
Control-arm bushings shot — front-end refresh kit + alignment.
AC won't hold charge — evac, leak-trace, condenser reseal.
Engine smokes on cold start — head gasket suspect, top-end teardown.
Transmission downshifts hard under load — rebuild estimate doubled.
Frame rust deeper than report indicated — cut, weld, refinish.
Cylinder #3 dead compression — full engine replacement.
Salt-line found behind dash — confirmed flood unit. Full electrical rewire or wholesale.
Title check pulled a salvage brand the auction missed. Disclosure + rework to retailable spec.
